git_policy.note: See rules/03_multi_agent_guardrails.md R39. Claude Code is the sole integrator of `main`; other agents/subagents work on feat/* branches and hand off via pull request. Enforced by GitHub branch protection on `main`, not by this field -- this note is a best-effort signal only, unverified whether the harness reads it.

subagents.name: harness
subagents.description: Default orchestrator. Reads feature_list.json and routes work.

subagents.name: spec-author
subagents.description: Produces specs in EARS notation. Never writes production code.

subagents.name: implementer
subagents.description: Executes tasks.md sequentially on the active feature.

subagents.name: reviewer
subagents.description: Verifies R<n>↔test traceability and runs checks.
